blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have substantially improved Text-to-SQL performance, yet existing NL2SQL systems largely assume that user queries are valid and answerable. As a result, models often generate executable SQL even for queries with flawed premises. We introduce premise critique ability in NL2SQL, namely the ability to recognize flawed queries and abstain from generating misleading SQL. To evaluate this capability, we propose PremiseSQL, a benchmark containing 1,800 flawed NL2SQL queries across four categories of premise failures, along with their 1,800 original queries. We further design an evaluation framework to measure intrinsic and prompt-induced premise-aware behavior across three prompting settings. Experiments on frontier LLMs show that current models are strongly premise-trusting by default and rarely critique flawed premises. Stronger critique-oriented prompting improves detection and abstention on flawed queries, but also increases false invalid judgments and suppresses SQL generation on originals. The code is available at https://github.com/vegeet/PremiseSQL.
blocks.zh: 最近大语言模型(LLMS)的进步大大地改善了Text对SQL的性能,然而现有的NL2SQL系统基本上假定用户查询是有效的和可回答的. 因此,模型往往产生可执行的SQL,甚至用于有缺陷的前提的查询. 我们在NL2SQL中引入了前提批评能力,即识别有缺陷的询问和避免产生误导性SQL的能力. 为了评价这种能力,我们提议PremiseSQL,这个基准包含1,800个有缺陷的NL2SQL查询,涉及四类前提故障,以及1,800个原始查询。 我们进一步设计了一个评价框架,以衡量三个触发环境内在和迅速引发的前提意识行为。 对前沿有限责任公司进行的实验表明,目前的模型在默认情况下具有强烈的前提信任,很少批评有缺陷的前提。 更强烈的以批评为导向的提示可以改善检测,对有缺陷的询问弃权,但也会增加虚假的无效判断并压制原作上SQL生成. 该代码可在https://github.com/vegeet/PremiseSQL查询.

blocks.en: Text-to-SQL (or NL2SQL) translates natural language (NL) questions into executable SQL given a database schema Popescu et al. (2003) . Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have substantially improved schema understanding, compositional reasoning, and cross-domain generalization in modern NL2SQL systems OpenAI et al. (2024) ; Touvron et al. (2023) ; Yang et al. (2025) ; DeepSeek AI (2025) ; Chang et al. (2024) ; Scholak et al. (2021) ; Yu et al. (2018) ; Pourreza and Rafiei (2023) .
blocks.zh: Text-to-SQL(或NL2SQL)将自然语言(NL)问题翻译为可执行 SQL 给一个数据库计划 Popescu等人(2003年). 大语言模型(LLMs)的近期进步在现代NL2SQL系统OpenAI等(2024)中大大提高了对计划的理解,组成推理,并实现了跨域通化;Touvron等(2023);Yang等(2025);DeepSeek AI(2025);Chan等(2024);Scholak等(2021);Yu等(2018);Pourreza和Rafiei(2023).

blocks.en: Despite this progress, existing Text-to-SQL research largely assumes that user questions are valid, well-formed, and answerable under the given schema Yu et al. (2018) ; Li et al. (2023) . Consequently, most prior work focuses on improving SQL generation accuracy, schema linking, and complex reasoning capabilities Wang et al. (2020) ; Scholak et al. (2021) ; Pourreza and Rafiei (2023) . However, this assumption is frequently violated in realistic scenarios. User questions may contain logically inconsistent conditions, false schema assumptions, missing premises, or requests beyond the capability of SQL and the underlying database.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,但现有的文本对SQL研究基本上假定用户的问题是有效的、完善的,并在给定的计划中可以回答的 于等 (2018); 李等 (2023). 因此,以前大多数工作的重点是提高SQL生成的准确性、计划联系和复杂的推理能力Wang等人(2020年);Scholak等人(2021年);Pourreza和Rafiei(2023年)。 然而,这种假设在现实情况下经常被违反。 用户问题可能包含逻辑上不一致的条件,虚假的计划假设,缺失的场地,或者超出SQL和基础数据库能力的要求.

blocks.en: Nevertheless, state-of-the-art NL2SQL models often generate executable SQL even for flawed queries, producing SQL that is syntactically valid but semantically invalid Ji et al. (2023) ; Whitehead et al. (2022) ; Ren et al. (2023) ; Huang et al. (2025) . In many cases, models implicitly repair problematic questions by injecting unsupported assumptions Lin et al. (2022) . Figure 1 illustrates this failure: although "person with id 5" is underdetermined by the schema, a model may silently map person to actor and emit executable SQL. The resulting SQL is syntactically valid but rests on an unsupported entity choice.
blocks.zh: 尽管如此,最先进的NL2SQL模型也常常产生即使是有缺陷的查询中可执行的SQL,产生SQL,在战术上是有效的,但明显无效的Ji等人(2023年);Whitehead等人(2022年);Ren等人(2023年); 黄等 (2025). 在许多情况下,模型通过注射无支持的假设Lin等(2022年)来隐含地修复有问题的问题. 图1说明了这一失败:虽然"有id 5的人"被"计划"低估,但一个模型可能会默默地将人映射到演员身上并放出可执行的SQL. 由此产生的SQL在战术上是有效的,但依赖于一个不支持的实体选择.

blocks.en:
We introduce premise critique ability in NL2SQL, namely the ability to recognize flawed queries and abstain from generating misleading SQL. Premise critique ability is orthogonal to conventional SQL generation accuracy: a model may produce executable SQL, or even generate SQL that coincidentally matches the user’s intent, while still failing to recognize that the provided question itself is ill-posed.
Concretely, it consists of two components: (1) premise validation , namely assessing query validity in the corresponding database context and identifying actual flaws; and (2) abstention , namely refraining from generating misleading SQL for flawed queries while maintaining SQL generation for valid queries.
blocks.zh:
我们在NL2SQL中引入了前提批评能力,即识别有缺陷的询问和避免产生误导性SQL的能力. 精确的批判能力与常规的 SQL 生成精度是正对的:一个模型可能会产生可执行的 SQL,甚至产生偶然与用户意图相匹配的 SQL,同时仍然无法识别所提供问题本身被错误置入.
具体而言,它由两个部分组成:(1)前提验证,即评估相应数据库背景中的查询有效性并找出实际缺陷;和(2)弃权,即避免对有缺陷的查询产生误导性SQL,同时保留SQL生成以进行有效查询.

blocks.en: To systematically evaluate this capability, we introduce PremiseSQL , to our knowledge the first benchmark specifically designed to evaluate premise critique ability in NL2SQL systems. Built upon two widely used Text-to-SQL datasets, Spider 1.0 Yu et al. (2018) and BIRD / BIRD-filtered Li et al. (2023) , PremiseSQL pairs 1,800 constructed flawed queries with their 1,800 unmodified source queries. It evaluates whether models can recognize flawed premises and abstain from generating misleading SQL, while maintaining SQL generation for original queries. We further evaluate frontier LLMs under three prompting settings, including Base , Implicit , and Explicit , to measure both intrinsic and prompt-induced premise-aware behavior.
blocks.zh: 为了系统地评价这种能力,我们引入了PremiseSQL, 据我们所知,第一个具体用来评价NL2SQL系统中的前提批评能力的基准。 由两个被广泛使用的Text-to-SQL数据集所建,Spider 1.0 Yu等 (2018年)和BIRD / BIRD-filtered Li等 (2023年),PremiseSQL对 1,800以其1,800个未经修改的源查询构建了有缺陷的查询. 它评价模型是否能够识别出有缺陷的前提并避免产生误导性的SQL,同时保持SQL生成用于原始查询. 我们进一步评估前沿有限责任公司在三个激励环境下,包括Base、Imblicit和Expective,以衡量内在和迅速引发的前提意识行为。

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的贡献如下:

blocks.en: • We formalize premise critique ability as a distinct requirement for reliable NL2SQL. • We introduce PremiseSQL , a taxonomy-guided benchmark comprising flawed queries as positive samples and their originals as negative samples. • We develop an evaluation framework that separates intrinsic critique from prompt-induced behavior. Experiments on 16 frontier LLMs reveal a shift from trusting flawed premises under standard prompting to frequently rejecting valid queries under explicit critique instructions.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 我们正式将前提批评能力作为可靠的NL2SQL的一个独特要求。 二. 支助 我们采用PremiseSQL,这是分类学指导基准,包括作为正样品的有缺陷的查询和作为负样品的原件。 我们制定评价框架,将内在批评与迅速引发的行为区分开来。 对16个边境有限责任公司进行的试验表明,从根据标准信任有缺陷的房舍转变为根据明确的批评指示经常拒绝有效的询问。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Unanswerable and Ambiguous Queries in NL2SQL
blocks.zh: 2.1 NL2SQL中无法回答和含糊的查询

blocks.en:
Prior work has explored unanswerable and ambiguous queries in NL2SQL. TriageSQL Zhang et al. (2020) formulates the problem as question intention classification, while Know What I Don’t Know Wang et al. (2023) further categorizes ambiguity and unanswerability cases. More recent work extends beyond classification-oriented formulations. TrustSQL Lee et al. (2024) introduces infeasible queries and proposes a reliability-oriented evaluation metric for trustworthy NL2SQL systems. Complementarily, NL2SQL-BUGs Liu et al. (2025) focuses on errors in NL2SQL translation and categorizes semantic errors into fine-grained types.
However, NL2SQL still lacks a fine-grained and comprehensive examination of diverse premise errors and the varying challenges they pose to models. PremiseSQL addresses this gap through a unified premise-error taxonomy.
blocks.zh:
先前的工作在NL2SQL中探讨了无法回答和模糊的询问. 三进制SQL 张等(2020年)将问题意图分类为问题意图分类,而"知我不知"王等(2023年)则将模糊和无法回答的案件进一步分类. 最近的工作超越了以分类为导向的提法。 信托SQL 李等编. (2024)引入了不可行的查询,并针对可信赖的NL2SQL系统提出了一个以可靠性为导向的评价度量表. NL2SQL-BUGs 作为补充 刘等. (2025)专注于NL2SQL翻译中的出错,将语义错误分类为细纹类型.
然而,NL2SQL仍然缺乏对各种前提错误及其对模型构成的不同挑战的精细而全面的审查. PremiseSQL通过统一的前提-错误分类来解决这一缺口.

blocks.en:
Beyond NL2SQL, prior work studies LLM robustness under adversarial, noisy, or logically flawed inputs.
For example, SQuADRUN Rajpurkar et al. (2018) introduces unanswerable questions, highlighting models’ tendency to produce confident but incorrect responses when no valid answer exists. AbstentionBench Kirichenko et al. (2025) provides a large-scale benchmark across 20 diverse datasets to assess abstention behavior.
Building on these, we cover more types of flawed queries in NL2SQL and examine premise critique under different levels of premise-aware prompting, revealing both the limitations of this capability in LLMs and how it can be elicited. The paired originals further allow us to distinguish evidence-grounded critique from instruction-driven rejection.
blocks.zh:
在NL2SQL之外,在对抗性、噪音或逻辑缺陷的投入下,前期工作研究LLM稳健性。
举例来说, SQuadrun Rajpurkar等人(2018年)提出了无法回答的问题,突出了模型在没有有效答案时产生自信但错误的答复的倾向. 放弃Bench Kirichenko等人(2025年)为评估弃权行为提供了20个不同数据集的大规模基准。
在此基础上,我们涵盖NL2SQL中更多类型的有缺陷的询问,并审查在不同层面的前提提示下对前提的批评,揭示了这种能力在LLMs中的局限性以及如何得到这种评价。 配对原作进一步使我们能够区分基于证据的批评和指令驱动的拒绝。

blocks.en: 3.2 Premise Taxonomy
blocks.zh: 3.2 精确分类学

blocks.en:
We further organize flawed premises into a unified taxonomy. (1) Expression Error refers to errors caused by ambiguous or unclear natural language expressions that prevent the query intent from being uniquely mapped to SQL; (2) Premise Contradiction captures queries whose assumptions are logically inconsistent or incompatible with the database schema; (3) Missing Premise refers to queries that omit essential assumptions, constraints, or schema information required for reliable SQL generation and execution; (4) Beyond Ability includes queries whose requirements exceed the expressive or reasoning capabilities of SQL and the given database, making them unanswerable under the available execution assumptions.
A complete taxonomy with fine-grained subcategories and definitions is shown in Table 1 .
blocks.zh:
我们进一步组织有缺陷的场所,形成统一的分类体系. (1)表达错误,指由于模糊或不明确的自然语言表达方式导致查询意向无法被独到地映射到SQL而出的错误; (2)精确对比性捕获假设逻辑上不一致或与数据库计划不相容的查询; (3)缺失对比性是指忽略了可靠SQL生成和执行所需的基本假设,约束,或计划信息的查询; (4)超越能力包括要求超过SQL和给定数据库的表达或推理能力的查询,使得这些查询在现有执行假设下无法回答.

blocks.en: 3.4 Prompting Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.4 提示议定书

blocks.en: To analyze how prompting affects premise critique behavior, we evaluate models under three prompting settings: Base , Implicit , and Explicit .
blocks.zh: 为了分析激励如何影响前提批评行为,我们在三个激励设置下评价模型: 基础,隐含, 和明确。

blocks.en: The Base setting follows the standard Text-to-SQL generation setup. Models are simply instructed to generate SQL for the given question and return a structured JSON output containing sql and reason , where sql denotes the generated SQL (or null when abstaining) and reason records the model’s explanation for its generation behavior. No additional warning is provided regarding potential flaws in the query.
blocks.zh: 基础设置遵循标准的文本到SQL生成设置. 模型被简单地指示为给定问题生成 SQL ,并返回包含 sql 和 理由的结构化的 JSON 输出,其中 sql 表示生成的 SQL (或弃权时无效) , 并记录模型生成行为的解释. 没有就查询中的潜在缺陷提出额外警告。

blocks.en: The Implicit setting introduces implicit premise-awareness guidance. Models are informed that the input question may contain errors and are asked to assess its validity before answering. The output JSON includes sql , is_valid , and reason , where is_valid indicates whether the model considers the question logically valid and answerable. This setting measures whether soft prompting can improve premise validation and abstention behavior.
blocks.zh: 隐含背景引入了隐含的前提认识指导. 模型被告知输入问题可能包含出错并被要求在回答前评估其有效性. 输出的 JSON 包含 sql , is_valid , 和 reason , 其中_valid 表示模型是否认为问题在逻辑上有效且可回答. 这种设定衡量软提示是否能改善前提验证和弃权行为.

blocks.en: The Explicit setting provides direct critique-oriented instructions. Models are explicitly told that the question contains logically flawed or incorrect premises, and are required to critically examine its assumptions before responding. The output format remains sql , is_valid , and reason . This setting examines premise critique behavior under an explicit assertion of a query flaw, which is supported for positive samples but false for negative samples.
blocks.zh: 《明确框架》提供了直接的以批评为导向的指示。 模式被明确告知,这一问题包含有逻辑缺陷或错误的前提,在作出答复之前必须严格审查假设。 输出格式仍然是 sql , 是 _ valid, 和 理由 。 这一设定在明确断言查询有缺陷的情况下审查前提批评行为,这种断言为阳性样本所支持,而阴性样本为虚假.

blocks.en: 3.5 Evaluation Framework
blocks.zh: 3.5 评价框架

blocks.en: For positive samples, three metrics are considered: SQL Behavior (SQL), Detection (DET), and Type Identification (TYPE). SQL Behavior measures the degree of abstention from generating misleading SQL for a flawed query, using a three-level ordinal score from 0 to 2. Detection evaluates whether the model recognizes that the query contains a premise flaw, and Type Identification measures whether it correctly identifies the corresponding failure type.
blocks.zh: 对于阳性样品,考虑的有三种度量:SQL行为(SQL),检测(DET)和类型识别(TYPE). SQL行为用从0到2的三级正则分数来测量对错误查询产生误导性SQL的弃权程度. 检测评价模型是否承认查询含有前提缺陷,而类型识别衡量方法是否正确识别出相应的故障类型.

blocks.en: For negative samples, two complementary metrics, namely SQL Generation (GEN) and Validity Judgment (VAL), are introduced. SQL Generation measures the proportion of negative samples for which the model generates SQL, reflecting whether it maintains generation for valid queries. GEN measures generation coverage; Appendix B.7 provides an execution-based validation showing that GEN closely tracks end-to-end execution success. Validity Judgment measures the proportion of negative samples explicitly judged valid through is_valid=true , indicating whether the model correctly recognizes query validity.
blocks.zh: 对于负面样品,采用了两个互补的衡量标准,即SQL生成和有效性判断。 SQL生成量测量模型生成SQL的负标本的比例,反映它是否维持生成以进行有效查询. GEN测量生成覆盖;附录B.7提供了基于执行的验证,表明GEN密切跟踪端到端执行的成功. 有效性判断通过-valid= truth来测量明确判定有效的负面样本的比例,表明模型是否正确承认了查询的有效性.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate premise critique ability on a diverse set of state-of-the-art LLMs. The evaluated models include ChatGLM-5.1 GLM-5 Team (2026) , Claude Opus 4.6 Anthropic (2026b) , Claude Sonnet 4.6 Anthropic (2026a) , Claude Opus 5.5 Anthropic (2026c) , DeepSeek V3.2 DeepSeek AI (2025) , DeepSeek V4.1 Flash DeepSeek-AI (2026) , Doubao Seed 2.0 Pro ByteDance (2026) , Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview Google (2026) , LLaMA 4 Maverick Meta AI (2026) , GPT-5.4 OpenAI (2026b) , GPT-5.6-Luna OpenAI (2026a) , GPT-6-Luna OpenAI (2026c) , GPT-6.1-Sol OpenAI (2026d) , and the 35B, 122B, and 397B variants of Qwen3.5 Qwen Team (2026) .
blocks.zh: 我们评价对各种最先进的法学硕士的前提批评能力。 被评价的型号包括ChatGLM-5.1 GLM-5 Team (2026),克洛德·奥普斯 4.6 Anthropic (2026b),克洛德·索内 4.6 Anthropic (2026a),克洛德·奥普斯 5.5 Anthropic (2026), DeepSeek V3.2 DeepSeek AI (2025), DeepSeek V4.1 Flash DeepSeek-AI (2026), Doubaobo种子 2.0 Pro ByteDance (2026),双米尼 3.1 Pro preventure Google (2026), LLAMA 4 Maverick Meta AI (2026), GPT 5.4 OpenAI (2026b), GPT-6-Luna OpenAI (2026c), GPT-6-Sol OpenAI (2026d), GPT-6.1-S OpenAI OpenAI (2026d)

blocks.en: Each of the 1,800 taxonomy-guided premise perturbations is paired with its unmodified source query. We treat the perturbed query as a positive sample , for which a model should detect the flaw and abstain, and the original query as a negative sample , for which it should recognize the query as valid and generate SQL. Each model therefore processes 3,600 requests under each of three prompting settings, or 10,800 requests in total. Across 16 models, our evaluation comprises 172,800 model responses. We use temperature 0 and the default API configuration for each model.
blocks.zh: 1800个分类学-导出前提扰动中,每一个都与其未经修改的源查询相配. 我们把扰动的查询当作一个正面的样本, 对于这个样本,模型应该检测出缺陷和弃权, 原始的查询应该当作负面的样本, 对于这个样本,它应该承认查询是有效的,并生成SQL. 因此,每个模型在三个提示设置下处理3 600项请求,即总共10 800项请求。 在16个模式中,我们的评价包括172 800个模式答复。 我们使用温度0和每个模型的默认API配置.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 3 presents model performance on flawed queries and their paired originals. Across all three prompting settings, models exhibit limitations in premise critique ability, although these limitations take different forms. Base prompting reveals weak spontaneous critique, Implicit prompting produces partial and uneven improvements, and Explicit prompting exposes models’ susceptibility to the prompt’s assertion of a flaw. Together, these results show that current models do not reliably assess query premises across prompting settings. Figure 3 further illustrates how model behavior shifts from Implicit to Explicit prompting. Appendix E provides multi-model case studies that instantiate the main flawed-query outcomes and the corresponding failures in validity judgment and SQL generation on original queries.
blocks.zh: 表3列出有缺陷的查询及其成对原件的模型性能。 在所有三种提示性设置中,模型在前提批评能力方面显示出局限性,尽管这些局限性的形式不同。 推导基础揭示出软弱自发的批评,隐性推导产生局部和不平衡的改善,而明确推导模型容易暴露出推导模型的缺陷。 这些结果表明,目前的模型无法可靠地评估各种提示设置的查询前提。 图3还说明了模式行为如何从“隐性”转向“明确”的诱导。 附 录 E提供了多模型的案例研究,对主要有缺陷的-query结果以及相应的有效性判断失败和对原始询问的SQL生成进行即时分析.

blocks.en: Table 3: Premise critique performance on positive and negative samples. SQL is normalized SQL Behavior; DET and TYPE denote Detection and Type Identification. GEN is the SQL-generation rate on original queries, and VAL is the rate at which the model explicitly recognizes those queries as valid. Darker teal indicates better performance.
blocks.zh: 表3:对阳性和阴性样本的精确评价。 SQL是常态化的SQL行为;DET和TYPE表示检测和类型识别. GEN是原始查询上的SQL生成率,而VAL是模型明确承认这些查询有效的速率. Darker Teal表示表现更好.

blocks.en: Under Base prompting, aggregate positive-sample scores are only 0.177 SQL, 0.319 DET, and 0.311 TYPE, whereas negative-sample GEN is 0.988. Even the strongest Base detector, Claude Opus 5.5 at 0.492, fails to identify more than half of the flaws. LLaMA 4 Maverick detects only 0.147 of flawed cases, though it generates SQL as expected for 0.998 of originals. Standard Text-to-SQL instructions therefore elicit limited spontaneous premise critique: models show weak ability to recognize and interpret flawed premises, while rarely exhibiting necessary abstention on flawed queries.
blocks.zh: 在 Base 提示下,总正样本分数只有0.177 SQL,0.319 DET和0.311 TYPE,而负样本GEN为0.988. 甚至最强的基地探测器克洛德·奥普斯(Claude Opus 5.5 at 0.492)也未能识别出一半以上的缺陷. 拉玛 4 马华克只检测出0.147个有缺陷的病例,虽然它生成了0.998个原作所预期的SQL. 因此,标准文本至SQL指令受到有限的自发前提批评:模型显示识别和解释有缺陷的前提的能力薄弱,而很少对有缺陷的询问表示必要的弃权。

blocks.en: Implicit validity guidance increases aggregate SQL, DET, and TYPE to 0.635, 0.672, and 0.619, respectively, while original-query GEN and VAL remain 0.903 and 0.826. The gains are substantial but uneven. DeepSeek V3.2 reaches the highest DET (0.898), yet its GEN and VAL on originals are only 0.455 and 0.437. Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview attains lower DET and TYPE (0.706 and 0.688) while preserving nearly all originals. Thus, a soft warning exposes some latent critique ability, but it neither closes the recognition–explanation gap nor produces uniformly reliable premise judgments.
blocks.zh: 隐性有效性指导将SQL、DET和TYPE的总量分别提高到0.635、0.672和0.619,而原-克热和VAL则保持0.903和0.826. 成果是巨大的,但不均衡。 DeepSeek V3.2达到最高的DET(0.898),但其GEN和VAL在正版上只有0.455和0.437. 双子座 3.1 Pro Preview在保留了几乎所有原作的同时,实现了较低的DET和TYPE(0.706和0.688). 因此,软警告暴露出一些潜在的批评能力,但它既不能弥合识别-解释差距,也不能产生一致可靠的前提判断。

blocks.en: Explicit prompting raises aggregate SQL, DET, and TYPE to 0.936, 0.931, and 0.790. Because this prompt asserts that a flaw exists, however, high scores can reflect compliance with that assertion rather than independent critique. The evaluation therefore tests whether critique follows the evidence: models should identify a supported flaw in perturbed queries, but should also reject the prompt’s unsupported claim of a flaw when processing originals. The latter requirement distinguishes genuine premise assessment from instruction-driven rejection. Nevertheless, aggregate GEN and VAL on originals fall to 0.523 and 0.321. Qwen3.5-397B is the clearest rejection case, scoring 0.998 SQL and 0.968 DET on flawed queries but only 0.004 GEN and 0.005 VAL on originals. Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview is less susceptible, retaining 0.941 GEN and 0.704 VAL. Overall, stronger instructions improve apparent critique performance without producing consistently evidence-grounded premise judgments.
blocks.zh: 明确提示将SQL、DET和TYPE的总和提高到0.936、0.931和0.790。 然而,由于这一提示断言存在缺陷,高分可以反映遵守这一断言,而不是独立批评。 因此,评估检验了批评是否遵循证据:模型应该找出扰动的询问中支持的缺陷,但也应该否定当事者在处理原件时对缺陷的不支持的说法。 后一项要求将真正的前提评估与指令驱动的拒绝区分开来。 尽管如此,正本上的GEN和VAL总比降为0.523和0.321. Quen3.5-397B是最明显的拒绝案件,在有缺陷的询问中得分为0.998 SQL和0.968 DET,但原作上只有0.004 GEN和0.005 VAL. 双子座 3.1 Pro Preview比较不易被感染,保留了0.941 GEN和0.704 VAL. 总的来说,更强有力的指示改进了明显的批评业绩,而没有作出一贯的循证前提判断。

blocks.en: Figure 3: DET–GEN shifts from Implicit to Explicit prompting across 16 models. Teal and sage bars denote flaw detection (DET) on flawed queries and SQL generation (GEN) on paired originals, respectively. Black caps mark Implicit scores, while bar endpoints and arrowheads mark Explicit scores; outward/inward arrows indicate increases/decreases. Explicit prompting increases DET but decreases GEN for every model, showing that stronger flaw cues improve detection at the cost of more false rejection of valid queries.
blocks.zh: 图3:DET-GEN从暗指转向明指16个模型。 Teal和sage条分别表示对有缺陷的查询的缺陷检测(DET)和对正本的SQL生成(GEN). 黑盖会标出隐性分数,而条端点和箭头会标出显性分数;出/入箭会标出增/减. 明确促进增加DET,但减少每个模型的GEN,显示更强的缺陷提示可以改善检测,而代价是更错误地拒绝有效的查询.

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Model Comparisons
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 模型比较

blocks.en: Aggregate trends conceal substantial variation within and across model families. Model rankings also shift across prompting settings.
blocks.zh: 总体趋势掩盖了模范家庭内部和之间的巨大差异。 模型排名也跨出提示设置.

blocks.en: Within model families, Base DET rises from 0.261 for GPT-5.4 to 0.313 for GPT-5.6-Luna, 0.386 for GPT-6-Luna, and 0.417 for GPT-6.1-Sol; TYPE follows the same ordering. Claude Opus 5.5 likewise improves Base DET from 0.281 to 0.492 relative to Opus 4.6 and raises Implicit TYPE from 0.536 to 0.646. Yet even the best Base result remains below 0.5, and the GPT ordering is not stable under stronger prompts.
blocks.zh: 在模范家庭中, 基础DET由GPT-5.4的0.261升至GPT-5.6-Luna的0.313;GPT-6-Luna的0.386;GPT-6.1-Sol的0.417;TYPE遵循相同的订单. Claude Opus 5.5同样改进了Base DET,与Opus 4.6相对从0.281到0.492,并将隐性TYPE从0.536提高到0.646. 然而,即使是最佳的Base结果仍然低于0.5,在更强烈的提示下,GPT订单也不稳定.

blocks.en: Other comparisons reinforce the absence of a general scaling trend. Under Implicit prompting, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash has much higher original-query GEN than V3.2 (0.926 versus 0.455), but lower DET on flawed queries (0.625 versus 0.898). The 35B Qwen variant also outperforms its larger counterparts on Implicit DET. Newer or larger models therefore show partial, setting-dependent gains rather than a consistent improvement in spontaneous premise critique.
blocks.zh: 其他的比较则加剧了没有总体比例趋势的情况。 在暗指下,DeepSeek V4.1 Flash具有比V3.2(0.926对0.455)高得多的原-克热能,但在有缺陷的查询上DET更低(0.625对0.898. 35B Quen的变体在隐性DET上也比其较大的同位素强. 因此,较新的或更大的模式显示的是部分的、取决于具体情况的收益,而不是自发的前提批评的持续改进。

blocks.en: 4.2.2 Validity Judgments and Behavior
blocks.zh: 4.2.2 效力判决和行为

blocks.en: We pool 115,200 outputs from Implicit and Explicit prompting and exclude 145 malformed flawed-query responses, retaining 57,455 flawed-query and 57,600 original-query outputs. Among the 47,801 flawed-query outputs with is_valid = false , 96.06% receive DET = 1 and 94.12% completely abstain; among the 9,654 with is_valid = true , 98.66% receive DET = 0 and 99.92% generate SQL. Thus, on flawed queries, the reported validity judgment closely tracks both flaw recognition and generation behavior, even when that judgment is incorrect.
blocks.zh: 我们汇集了来自 " 隐性和明确性 " 的115 200个产出,并排除了145个有缺陷的排泄物反应,保留了57 455个有缺陷的排泄物和57 600个原始排泄物。 在47,801个有缺陷的平滑产物中,有_有效=虚假,96.06%获得DET=1,94.12%完全弃权;在9,654个有_有效=真实,98.66%获得DET=0,99.92%生成SQL. 因此,在有缺陷的询问中,所报告的有效性判断密切跟踪缺陷识别和生成行为,即使这种判断是不正确的。

blocks.en: The originals show why such consistency does not imply correctness. Of the 24,568 original-query outputs with is_valid = false , 16,502 (67.17%) contain no SQL. By contrast, SQL is generated in 33,010 of the 33,032 original-query outputs (99.93%) with is_valid = true . Models therefore tend to act on their own validity judgment: when the judgment is wrong, the generation decision often follows the same error.
blocks.zh: 原文说明了为什么这种一致性并不意味着正确。 在24,568个原始平整输出中,有活性=虚假,16,502(67.17%)没有SQL。 相形之下,SQL在33,032个原始-静态输出(99.93%)中生成了33,010个,其中SQL为"真实". 因此,模型往往根据自身的有效性判断行事:当判断错误时,生成决定往往遵循相同的错误.

blocks.en: Explicit prompting amplifies this problem. Among outputs declaring the query invalid, the proportion corresponding to flawed queries falls from 20,100 of 25,119 (80.02%) under Implicit prompting to 27,701 of 47,250 (58.63%) under Explicit prompting. Equivalently, original-query outputs account for 41.37% of all invalid judgments under Explicit prompting. The resulting increase in false invalid judgments suggests that models rely too heavily on the prompt’s premise that the query is flawed, even when their judgments and generation behavior are internally consistent.
blocks.zh: 明确促使这一问题加剧。 在宣布查询无效的产出中,与有缺陷的查询相对应的比例从暗指的25,119个(80.02%)中的20,100个下降到暗指的47,250个(58.63%)中的27,701个。 同样,在明确提示下,原始平衡产出占所有无效判决的41.37%。 由此导致的虚假无效判断的增加表明,模型过于依赖提示的前提,即查询存在缺陷,即使其判断和生成行为在内部是一致的.

blocks.en: 4.2.3 Automatic Evaluation and Reliability
blocks.zh: 4.2.3 自动评价和可靠性

blocks.en: All model outputs are independently scored by GPT-5.4 and Claude Opus 4.6 under identical instructions and scoring definitions. Figure 7 presents a representative evaluation prompt, while Appendix B.2 provides the complete rubrics and validation details. Inter-evaluator Cohen’s κ \kappa reaches 0.9737 for SQL Behavior, 0.9100 for Detection, and 0.8586 for Type Identification.
blocks.zh: 所有模型输出均由GPT-5.4和克洛德·奥普斯·4.6在相同的指令和打分定义下独立打分. 图7提供了具有代表性的评价提示,而附录B.2提供了完整的标题和验证细节。 评估员科恩的off\kappa达到0.9737SQL行为,0.9100检测,0.8586类型识别.

blocks.en: We further verify the protocol on 2,160 randomly sampled outputs from one open-weight model ( DeepSeek V3.2 ) and one proprietary model ( GPT-5.4 ). Against two human annotators, the mean Cohen’s κ \kappa scores are 0.9701, 0.9545, and 0.9072 for Claude Opus 4.6, and 0.9567, 0.9355, and 0.8188 for GPT-5.4, on SQL Behavior, Detection, and Type Identification, respectively. These results support the reliability of the automatic evaluation used below.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步核实从一个开放式模型(DeepSeek V3.2)和一个专有模型(GPT-5.4)随机抽取的2,160个产出的协议。 与两个人类注解者相比,科恩的平均分数为克洛德·奥普斯4.6的0.9701分,0.9545分和克洛德·奥普斯4.6分和GPT-5.4的0.9567分,分别是SQL行为、检测和类型识别的0.8188分。 这些结果支持下文使用的自动评价的可靠性。

blocks.en: 4.3 Error-Type Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 错误-类型分析

blocks.en: Type identification remains more demanding than general flaw detection. TYPE is below DET in every setting, and the aggregate gap widens to 0.141 under Explicit prompting. Table 4 therefore breaks down the Implicit results by premise-error type.
blocks.zh: 类型识别仍然比一般缺陷检测要求更高. TYPE在每个场合都低于DET,在"明确提示"下,总差距会扩大至0.141. 因此,表4按假设-错误类型分列了隐性结果。

blocks.en: Table 4: Performance by taxonomy error type under Implicit prompting, aggregated across all 16 models and both datasets with labels averaged over two judges.
blocks.zh: 表4:按“隐形提示”下的分类误差类型分列的性能,在所有16个模型和两个数据集的分类误差均取自两个法官。

blocks.en: The results reveal a pronounced dependence on how premise flaws are expressed. Contradictions are easiest(DET and TYPE above 0.91), while ambiguity and unclear intent are hardest (DET below 0.25; TYPE below 0.14). Missing-premise cases fall between these extremes; models also perform relatively well on queries that exceed SQL expressibility or require external knowledge. Taken together, the pattern suggests that Implicit prompting elicits critique mainly when a flaw appears as an overt incompatibility or recognizable capability boundary. It is much less effective when detecting the flaw requires reasoning about under-specification or absent information, indicating that premise critique remains cue-dependent rather than robust across error forms.
blocks.zh: 结果表明,人们明显依赖前提缺陷的表达方式。 矛盾比较容易(DET和TYPE高于0.91),而模糊和不明的意图则最难(DET低于0.25;TYPE低于0.14). 缺少真实性的案件介于这些极端之间;模型在超过SQL可表达性或需要外部知识的查询上也表现相对较好. 总体来看,这一模式表明,隐性诱发主要在缺陷看来是明显不相容或可识别的能力界限时引起批评。 如果发现缺陷需要推理说明不足或缺乏信息,说明前提批评仍然取决于提示,而不是对错误表格的强烈批评,那么效果就低得多了。

blocks.en: 4.4 From Error Types to Failure Behaviors
blocks.zh: 4.4 从错误类型到失败行为

blocks.en: The preceding error-type analysis establishes which premise flaws are difficult to recognize, but it does not explain what models do with those flaws when critique fails. We therefore move from an input-level taxonomy to a response-level account. Whereas an error category characterizes a query flaw in its database context, a failure mechanism identifies the observable operation through which the model makes the query appear answerable.
blocks.zh: 前面的错误类型分析确定了哪些前提缺陷难以识别,但它并没有解释批评失败时这些缺陷的模型有什么作用. 因此,我们从输入一级的分类学转向反应一级的账户。 虽然一个错误类别是其数据库上下文中查询缺陷的特征,但故障机制却确定了该模型使查询看起来可以回答的可观察操作。

blocks.en: We annotate 8,000 eligible failures with four non-exclusive mechanisms: Assumption Injection (M01) introduces an unsupported interpretation, value, or proxy; Contradiction Reinterpretation (M02) modifies incompatible requirements; Context/Evidence Misuse (M03) treats partial schema or example evidence as conclusive; and Explicit Constraint Omission (M04) drops a complete requirement. Attribution requires strict agreement between two judges, with strong automatic and human reliability (macro κ = 0.8183 \kappa=0.8183 and 0.9434 0.9434 , respectively; see Appendix C for details).
blocks.zh: 我们用四种非排他性机制对8 000项合格的失败进行说明:假设注射(M01)引入了一种不支持的解释、价值或代理;矛盾重新解释(M02)修改了不相容的要求;背景/证据误用(M03)将部分计划或实例证据视为结论性证据;以及明确约束(M04)放弃了完全的要求。 归属要求两名法官之间有严格的协议,具有很强的自动性和人性的可靠性(分别是:0.883\kappa=0.883和0.94340.9434;详见附录C)。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Failure-mechanism incidence across prompting settings. Lines show the percentage of eligible failures assigned each mechanism by both judges. The M01–M03 reversal shows that stronger critique instructions shift residual failures from silent assumption injection to overinterpreting limited evidence rather than eliminating them, while M02 and M04 remain rare.
blocks.zh: 图4:各提示设置的失败机制事件。 线条显示两位法官分配给每个机制的合格失败的百分比。 M01-M03倒置显示,更强烈的批评指令将剩余失败从静态假设注入转向过度解释有限证据,而不是去除它们,而M02和M04则仍然罕见.

blocks.en: Among the eligible failures analyzed across prompting settings, M01 is the dominant failure mechanism (72.60%), followed by M03 (10.75%), while M02 (1.38%) and M04 (0.86%) remain rare. More importantly, Figure 4 shows a marked redistribution across prompting settings. From Base to Explicit prompting, M01 decreases from 81.03% to 31.12%, whereas M03 increases from 1.46% to 58.06%; the Implicit setting lies between these endpoints. Stronger instructions suppress silent completion of missing query premises, yet the remaining failures increasingly arise because models overinterpret limited schema or example evidence when deciding whether, and how, the premise is defective. The association with prompting setting is substantial for M01 (Cramér’s V = 0.356 V=0.356 ) and stronger for M03 ( V = 0.581 V=0.581 ), with Holm-adjusted p < 0.001 p<0.001 in both cases.
blocks.zh: 在经过催化环境分析的合格失败中,M01是主要的失败机制(72.60%),其次是M03(10.75%),而M02(1.38%)和M04(0.86%)仍然很少。 更重要的是,图4显示在各种提示性设置中出现了明显的再分配。 从基础到明确提示,M01从81.03%下降到31.12%,而M03从1.46%上升到58.06%;隐含设定位于这些终点之间。 更强的指令压制了缺失查询处所的静态完成,然而剩余的故障却越来越出现,因为模型在决定该前提是否和如何有缺陷时过度解释有限的方案或实例证据. 对M01(Cramér的V=0.356 V=0.356)和M03(V=0.581 V=0.581)而言,具有催化设置的关联程度相当高,两者均适用Holm调整后p < 0.001 p < 0.001。

blocks.en: Mechanism-level analysis therefore complements the error taxonomy by showing how an observed premise flaw is converted into an apparently answerable query. Despite their different surface forms, these failures reveal a shared limitation in that models tend to produce apparently answerable interpretations without recognizing the underlying premise flaws.
blocks.zh: 因此,机制层面的分析通过显示所观察到的前提缺陷如何转化为显然可以回答的查询来补充错误分类。 尽管其表面形式不同,但这些失败揭示了一种共同的局限性,即模型往往产生显然可问责的解释,而不承认基本的前提缺陷。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we introduce PremiseSQL , to our knowledge the first benchmark for evaluating premise critique ability in NL2SQL systems. PremiseSQL contains 1,800 flawed queries covering 9 fine-grained error types and their 1,800 originals as positive and negative samples, respectively.
Experiments under Base, Implicit, and Explicit prompting settings reveal a clear reliability gap in current NL2SQL systems. Models often trust user assumptions and generate misleading SQL under standard settings. Even when explicitly prompted to scrutinize premises, they struggle to assess them reliably. Models further struggle with subtle and implicit premise flaws, showing that strong SQL generation does not necessarily imply trustworthy premise-aware reasoning.
We hope PremiseSQL can facilitate future research on more reliable and premise-aware NL2SQL systems.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们介绍了PremiseSQL, 据我们所知,这是评价NL2SQL系统的前提批评能力的第一个基准。 PremiseSQL包含有1,800个有缺陷的查询,分别覆盖了9个细纹出错类型及其1,800个原件作为正反样本.
Base, Imbility, and Explosible pointing settings)下的实验揭示出当前NL2SQL系统中存在明显的可靠性差距. 模型往往信任用户假设,并在标准设置下产生误导性的SQL. 即使明确要求审查房地,他们也难以可靠地评估房地。 模型进一步与微妙而隐含的前提缺陷相抗争,表明强大的SQL一代并不一定意味着值得信赖的前提-意识推理.
我们希望PremiseSQL能够促进今后对更加可靠和具有前提意识的NL2SQL系统的研究.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Our work has several limitations.
First, PremiseSQL focuses on English NL2SQL benchmarks and may not generalize to multilingual settings or real-world interactive database systems.
Second, although the benchmark covers multiple premise failure categories, the constructed errors are still taxonomy-driven and may not fully capture naturally occurring user mistakes.
Finally, our evaluation relies partially on LLM-based automatic judges, which may introduce evaluation bias despite strong agreement with human annotations.
blocks.zh:
我们的工作有几个局限性。
首先,PremiseSQL侧重于英语NL2SQL基准,可能不会被概括到多语种设置或现实世界交互式数据库系统.
第二,虽然基准涵盖多个前提故障类别,但构建出的错误仍然由分类学驱动,可能无法完全捕捉自然发生的用户错误.
最后,我们的评价部分依赖于基于LLM的自动法官,尽管对人的说明有强烈的一致意见,但这些法官可能会引入评价偏颇。

After removing self-evaluation, the aggregate SQL, DET, and TYPE scores change by less than 0.001 in every prompting setting. The leading models also remain unchanged: Claude Opus 5.5 under Base prompting, DeepSeek V3.2 under Implicit prompting, and GPT-5.4 for Explicit DET and TYPE.

blocks.en: We further apply a stricter family-disjoint evaluation in which all OpenAI models are scored only by Claude Opus 4.6 and all Claude models are scored only by GPT-5.4; models from other families retain the two-judge average. Across the nine setting–metric combinations, aggregate scores change by at most 0.0016, the top-ranked model remains unchanged, and the original and family-disjoint model rankings have Spearman correlations ranging from 0.944 to 1.000. These results indicate that judge–target family overlap does not materially affect the aggregate results, leading models, or conclusions about prompting behavior. GEN and VAL are unaffected because they are derived directly from the models’ structured outputs rather than from automatic evaluator judgments.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步采用更严格的家庭-离散评价,其中所有OpenAI模型只有克洛德·奥普斯·4.6的得分,所有克洛德模型只有GPT-5.4的得分;其他家庭的模型保留了双判断平均分. 在9个设置-度量组合中,总分变化最多为0.0016分,排名最高的模型保持不变,原始和家族-脱节模型排名的Spearman相关比例从0.944到1000. 这些结果表明,法官-目标家庭的重叠并不对总体结果、主要模型或关于激励行为的结论产生实质性影响。 GEN和VAL没有受到影响,因为它们直接来自模型的结构化产出,而不是自动评价判断。

blocks.en: B.6 Paired Evaluation Design
blocks.zh: B.6 评价设计

blocks.en: The paired inputs expose a progression from under-critique to instruction-driven rejection. Each pair contrasts an original query–context combination with its perturbed counterpart. Reliable critique should change the response to the perturbation while maintaining correct validity judgments and SQL generation for originals. Base prompting usually answers both; stronger prompts increase abstention, but Explicit prompting often suppresses originals as well. The separation among DET, TYPE, and SQL on flawed queries and VAL and GEN on originals therefore distinguishes evidence-based critique from broad rejection.
blocks.zh: 配对的投入暴露出从低标准到教学驱动的拒绝。 每一对都将原始查询 - 文本组合与被扰动的对等版本形成对比. 可靠的批评应改变对扰动的反应,同时保持正确的有效性判断和原作的SQL生成. 碱性催化通常既能回答两个问题;更强的催化增加弃权,但明确催化也往往会压制原始物。 因此,DET、TYPE和SQL之间在有缺陷的询问和VAL和GEN在原件上的分离,将循证批评与广泛的拒绝区分开来。

blocks.en: The five measures provide complementary evidence about premise critique behavior. DET records whether any flaw is noticed, TYPE whether the intended defect is explained, and SQL whether that assessment changes generation. On originals, VAL records the explicit judgment and GEN the action. Their divergence is informative: under Explicit prompting, LLaMA 4 Maverick retains 0.974 GEN but only 0.363 VAL, so it often generates despite incorrectly judging an original query as flawed; Qwen3.5-397B is low on both and instead follows a broad rejection policy. Evaluation on originals prevents either pattern from being mistaken for robust critique.
blocks.zh: 这五项措施为前提批评行为提供了补充证据。 DET记录了是否注意到任何缺陷,TYPE是否解释意图缺陷,以及SQL评估是否改变生成. 在原件上,VAL记录了明确的判断和GEN的行动. 他们的分歧是翔实的:在明确提示下,LLaMA 4 马华保留了0.974 GEN,但只保留了0.363 VAL,因此尽管错误地判断出原始查询有缺陷,它还是经常生成;而Quen3.5-397B在两者上都很低,反而遵循了广泛的拒绝政策. 对原件的评价可以防止两种模式被误认为是强烈批评。

blocks.zh: B.7 基于执行的SQL生成验证

blocks.en: GEN is designed to measure generation coverage, namely whether a model preserves SQL generation on valid original queries. GEN and VAL are evaluated on all 1,800 original queries. For the supplementary execution-based analysis, we retain 1,726 originals whose gold SQL produces a reliable reference result in our SQLite evaluation environment; the remaining 74 are excluded only from this analysis because their execution correctness cannot be determined reliably. This yields 27,616 model–query outputs per prompting setting across the 16 evaluated models.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 8 , GEN closely tracks overall execution accuracy, whereas execution accuracy conditional on generation remains comparatively stable across prompting settings. Across the 48 model–setting combinations, GEN is strongly correlated with EX (Pearson’s r = 0.990 r=0.990 , p < .001 p<.001 ; Spearman’s ρ = 0.888 \rho=0.888 , p < .001 p<.001 ). Under Base prompting, the correlation is weaker ( r = 0.434 r=0.434 , p = .093 p=.093 ) because GEN is near its upper bound for almost all models, leaving little variation across models.

blocks.en: More directly, the model-level change in GEN from Implicit to Explicit prompting is strongly correlated with the corresponding change in EX (Pearson’s r = 0.992 r=0.992 , p < .001 p<.001 ; Spearman’s ρ = 0.985 \rho=0.985 , p < .001 p<.001 ). The decline in overall execution accuracy under Explicit prompting is therefore primarily associated with suppressed SQL generation rather than reduced correctness among the SQL outputs that remain. These results do not make GEN a substitute for execution accuracy; instead, they support its intended use as a measure of whether models preserve SQL generation on valid queries.

blocks.en: B.8 Bootstrap Uncertainty Analysis
blocks.zh: B.8 不确定因素分析

blocks.en: We assess the uncertainty of the principal model- and error-level comparisons using 10,000 bootstrap replicates. For comparisons across prompting settings or models, each replicate resamples the 1,800 aligned query instances with replacement, preserving the paired structure of the observations. For error-type results, we resample the 200 source queries within each error type while retaining all outputs from the 16 evaluated models and both judges for each sampled query. We report percentile 95% confidence intervals and two-sided centered-bootstrap tests. These intervals quantify uncertainty over benchmark queries; the evaluated models and judges are treated as fixed.
blocks.zh: 我们利用10 000个靴子复制物评估主要模型和误差水平比较的不确定性。 为了在提示设置或模型之间进行比较,每个都用替换复制1 800个对齐的查询实例,保留观测的对齐结构。 对于出错类型的结果,我们重新对每个出错类型中的200个源查询进行采样,同时保留16个评价模型的所有输出以及每个抽样查询的两个判断. 我们报告95%的置信间隔 和双侧中心波纹测试 这些间隔将基准查询的不确定性量化;被评价的模型和法官被视为固定的。

None of the 32 confidence intervals crosses zero, and all changes remain significant after Holm correction ( p adj < .004 p_{\mathrm{adj}}<.004 ). Even the smallest GEN decrease, observed for LLaMA 4 Maverick, remains distinguishable from zero. blocks.en: Paired comparisons support the claim that model rankings depend on the prompting setting. GPT-6.1-Sol exceeds GPT-5.4 in Base DET by 0.156 (95% CI [0.135, 0.176], p < .001 p<.001 ), whereas their difference under Implicit prompting is not significant (0.014, 95% CI [ − 0.004 -0.004 , 0.033], p = .129 p=.129 ). Under Explicit prompting, the ordering reverses: GPT-5.4 exceeds GPT-6.1-Sol by 0.050 (95% CI [0.039, 0.061], p < .001 p<.001 ).

The non-monotonic Qwen comparison is also statistically supported. Under Implicit prompting, Qwen3.5-35B exceeds Qwen3.5-122B in DET by 0.069 (95% CI [0.054, 0.086], p < .001 p<.001 ) and Qwen3.5-397B by 0.057 (95% CI [0.040, 0.074], p < .001 p<.001 ). The difference between the 122B and 397B variants is not significant ( − 0.013 -0.013 , 95% CI [ − 0.028 -0.028 , 0.002], p = .097 p=.097 ). Thus, the 35B result is robust, but it should be interpreted as a setting-specific comparison rather than a general advantage of smaller models.

blocks.en: The DeepSeek comparison further illustrates why performance cannot be summarized by a single ordering. Relative to DeepSeek V3.2 under Implicit prompting, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash has substantially higher GEN on originals ( + 0.471 +0.471 , 95% CI [0.448, 0.494], p < .001 p<.001 ) but lower DET on flawed queries ( − 0.274 -0.274 , 95% CI [ − 0.296 -0.296 , − 0.252 -0.252 ], p < .001 p<.001 ).

blocks.en: Table 10 confirms that the large differences across error types are not explained by query sampling variation. Relative to the two expression-error subcategories, the two contradiction subcategories are higher by 0.695 in SQL Behavior (95% CI [0.670, 0.718]), 0.730 in DET (95% CI [0.705, 0.754]), and 0.807 in TYPE (95% CI [0.785, 0.828]); all three differences have p < .001 p<.001 . blocks.zh: 表10证实,不同错误类型之间的巨大差异不是通过查询抽样变化来解释的。 相较于两个表达-过激子类,两个矛盾子类在SQL行为上较高了0.695个(95% CI [0.670, 0.718]),在DET上较高了0.730个(95% CI [0.705, 0.754]),在TYPE上较高了0.807个(95% CI [0.785, 0.828]);所有三个差异都有p <.001 p < 001. 因此,关于公开的矛盾比含糊不清容易得多的结论十分有力,而若干缺失的精确分类的间隔较大,表明查询层次的差异更大。

blocks.en: Appendix C Failure-Mechanism Attribution
blocks.zh: 附录C 失败机制 归属

blocks.en: C.1 Mechanism Definitions and Annotation Protocol
blocks.zh: C.1 机制定义和说明议定书

blocks.en: This analysis builds on the behavioral labels previously assigned by GPT-5.4 and Claude Opus 4.6. We use their existing SQL Behavior , Detection , and Type Identification judgments to identify eligible failures. For mechanism attribution, a separate evaluator pair, GPT-6.1-Sol and Claude Opus 5.5, assigns M01–M04 to these selected failures without re-evaluating the three behavioral dimensions.
blocks.zh: 这一分析基于之前由GPT-5.4和克洛德·奥普斯·4.6指派的行为标签. 我们使用他们现有的 SQL 行为, 检测, 和类型识别判断 找出合格的失败。 对于机制归属,一个单独的评估对称,GPT-6.1-Sol和克洛德·奥普斯·5.5,为这些选定的失败分配了M01-M04,而没有重新评价三个行为维度.

blocks.en: Each sampled response is annotated independently by the two mechanism-attribution judges using the same final attribution prompt. The task is multi-label rather than four-way classification: each judge must assess M01–M04 exactly once, and a response may receive multiple mechanisms or none. Table 16 gives the positive tests and the principal boundaries used in the prompt.
blocks.zh: 每个抽样答复均由两名机制归属法官使用相同的最终归属提示符独立附加说明。 任务是多标签而不是四向分类:每位法官必须精确评估M01-M04一次,答复可能得到多种机制或没有. 表16给出了阳性测试和即时使用的主要边界.

blocks.en: For each item, the judges receive (i) the flawed question and its source error type and flaw description; (ii) the tested model’s response, separated into its reason and SQL ; (iii) the schema and auxiliary evidence actually exposed to the tested model, together with provenance and exposure-status fields; (iv) the validated SQL Behavior , Detection , and Type Identification labels; (v) the complete reference schema and its provenance, when available; (vi) the paired valid question, SQL, and evidence used during benchmark construction; and (vii) data-coverage and other recovered context metadata.
blocks.zh: 对于每个项目,法官都收到(一) 有缺陷的问题及其出处错误类型和缺陷描述;(二) 被测试模型的答复,分为其理由和SQL;(三) 实际暴露于被测试模型的计数和辅助证据,以及出处和出处-状态域;(四) 经验证的SQL行为、检测和类型识别标签;(五) 完整的参考计划及其出处,如果有的话;(六) 成对的有效问题,SQL,以及基准构建过程中使用的证据;和(七) 数据覆盖和其他回收的上下文元数据。

blocks.en: For every mechanism, a judge returns one of supported , not_supported , or uncertain . supported requires the mechanism’s positive test and the required evidence; not_supported means the available record is sufficient to determine that the test is not met; and uncertain is reserved for cases in which missing context prevents a defensible decision. Evidence for M01, M02, and M04 must include an exact quote of the affected requirement from the current flawed question and an exact quote from the response’s reason or SQL showing the transformation. M03 instead requires an erroneous availability or answerability inference in the response plus counterevidence from verified model-visible context. The output also records the target requirement, transformation type, context basis, a concise explanation, and three control fields: whether the target is complete and explicit, whether any partial implementation remains, and whether the response supplies a concrete replacement. Deterministic post-processing validates the required quotes, context basis, control fields, and same-target exclusivity, and then derives the positive-label list only from validated supported verdicts.
blocks.zh: 对于每个机制,法官返回一个支持的、不支持的、或不确定的.支持需要机制的阳性测试和必要的证据;不支持意味着现有记录足以确定测试没有得到满足;对于缺失背景无法作出合理决定的案件,则有不确定性。 M01、M02和M04的证据必须包括从当前有缺陷的问题中确切引用受影响的要求,以及从答复的理由或显示转变的SQL中确切引用。 相反,M03要求在答复中作出错误的可用性或可回答性推断,加上来自经核实的模型可见上下文的反证。 产出还记录了目标要求,转型类型,上下文基础,简洁的解释,以及三个控制字段:目标是否完整和明确,是否有任何部分执行保留,反应是否提供混凝土替换. 决定后处理验证了所需的引号,上下文基础,控制字段,以及同目标独占性,然后从经验证支持的判决中取出正标签列表.

blocks.en: M01, M02, and M04 are mutually exclusive when they describe the same atomic requirement: a concrete substitute is M01, a changed satisfaction relation for an explicit contradiction is M02, and complete disappearance without replacement is M04. They may coexist only when they concern distinct requirements. M03 is independent, but the same inference from nonappearance in bounded examples is not counted again as M01. Complete abstention alone is not M04, and ordinary SQL implementation defects are outside this mechanism taxonomy.
blocks.zh: M01,M02,和M04在描述相同的原子要求时是相互排斥的:一个混凝土替代是M01,一个明显矛盾的改变的满足关系是M02,没有替换的完全消失是M04. 它们只有在涉及不同要求时才能共存。 M03是独立的,但同样来自没有出现在受约束的例子中的推论不再被计算为M01. 完全弃权本身并不是M04,普通的SQL执行缺陷不在这种机制分类法之外.

blocks.en: The same binary coding is used for automatic and human reliability analyses: supported is coded as 1, whereas both not_supported and uncertain are coded as 0. A mechanism enters the reported label set only when both attribution judges mark it as supported . This rule is applied separately to M01–M04, so the final label set is simply the intersection of the judges’ supported labels; their complete four-label combinations need not match.
blocks.zh: 同样的二进制编码用于自动和人性可靠性分析:支持被编码为1,而不支持和不确定均被编码为0. 一个机制只有在两个归属裁判都将其标记为支持时才输入报告标签集。 此规则被单独应用于M01-M04,因此最终的标签集只是法官所支持的标签的相接点;其完整的四标签组合不需要匹配.

blocks.en: Figure 8 reproduces the task and output contract from the final prompt. The prompt evaluates observable response operations rather than inferring a mechanism from the validated outcome scores; its label-specific decision tests and exclusions are stated in Table 16 and the preceding paragraphs.
blocks.zh: 图8转载了最后提示中的任务和产出合同。 即时评估可观察到的反应操作,而不是从经核实的结果分数中推断出一种机制;表16和前几段说明了其具体标签的决定测试和排除。

blocks.en: C.2 Eligibility and Sampling
blocks.zh: C.2 资格和抽样

blocks.en: The mechanism analysis begins from outputs that both primary evaluators, Claude Opus 4.6 and GPT-5.4, independently regard as failures. All three evaluation fields must be valid: Detection and Type Identification must be binary, and SQL Behavior must be in { 0 , 1 , 2 } \{0,1,2\} . An output is a candidate failure when Type Identification = 0 =0 or SQL Behavior ≠ 2 \neq 2 . Candidate records are paired only when their sample identity and their database ID, question, reason, and SQL match exactly. The two evaluators must then agree on all three fields. Records with non-string reasons, schema-placeholder outputs, or no usable reason/SQL evidence are excluded because they cannot support mechanism attribution.
blocks.zh: 机制分析的起点是主要评价者克洛德·奥普斯·4.6和GPT-5.4将失败独立视为失败的产出。 所有三个评价字段都必须是有效的: 检测和类型识别必须是二进制的,而SQL行为必须是{0, 1, 2}} {0, 1, 2} {0, 1, 2} 。 输出是类型识别=0=0或SQL行为QQ2\neq 2时的候选失败. 候选人记录只有在他们的样本身份和数据库ID,质询,理由和SQL完全吻合时才进行配对. 然后,两名评价员必须就所有三个领域达成一致。 有非字符串原因、计程器置放器输出或无可用理由/SQL证据的记录因不能支持机制归属而被排除在外。

blocks.en: This strict wash retains 36,684 responses: 18,701 from BIRD and 17,983 from Spider. The exclusion log contains 4,258 otherwise matched candidates: 4,035 evaluator disagreements, 180 non-string reasons, and 43 SQL schema placeholders. We then restore the original generation context and paired valid reference. Before sampling, we remove 4,279 outputs that correctly identify the flaw but still answer it, 4,801 E3.2 cases for which the historical reduced-schema exposure cannot be recovered, and 31 cases without a recoverable paired-valid reference. This leaves 27,573 eligible failures (13,709 BIRD and 13,864 Spider).
blocks.zh: 这种严格的洗涤保留了36,684个响应:来自BIRD的18,701个和来自蜘蛛的17,983个. 排除记录包含4,258个其他匹配的候选者:4,035个评价者分歧、180个非字符串原因和43个SQL方案占位符。 然后恢复原始的生成上下文并配对有效引用. 在取样之前,我们删除了4,279个正确识别出缺陷但仍能解决的输出,4,801个E3.2型病例,这些病例的历史降低-中度接触无法被回收,31个病例没有可收回的对等-验证参考. 这使得27,573个符合条件的失败(13,709个BIRD和13,864个Spider).

blocks.en: For each dataset–model combination, we sample exactly 250 responses, yielding 16 × 2 × 250 = 8,000 16\times 2\times 250=8{,}000 observations. Sampling strata are prompting setting × \times source error category. Every nonempty stratum receives at least one observation, and the remaining quota is allocated approximately in proportion to stratum size by the largest-remainder method. Within each stratum, records are ranked deterministically by a SHA-256 hash with seed 42. The final sample contains 4,587 Base, 2,433 Implicit, and 980 Explicit responses. Because of the unrecoverable historical schema exposure noted above, E3.2 is not represented in this mechanism-attribution sample. All reported mechanism incidences are calculated directly from these 8,000 sampled responses without reweighting.
blocks.zh: 对于每个数据集-模型组合,我们精确地抽样了250个响应,得出16×2×250=8000个16\times 2\times 250=8{,}000个观测结果. 采样层正在提示设置 \ times 源错误类别 。 每个非空地层至少得到一个观察,其余的配额按照最大-剩余方法与地层大小的比例分配。 在每一层中,记录按有42个种子的SHA-256散列排列。 最后样本包括4 587个碱基、2 433个隐形和980个明确答复。 由于上述无法恢复的历史计划暴露,E3.2在此机制-归属样本中没有被代表. 所有报告的机制事件都是直接从这8 000个抽样答复中计算的,没有重新加权。

blocks.en: Across the 8,000 sampled failures, strict two-judge consensus identifies M01 in 5,808 responses, M02 in 110, M03 in 860, and M04 in 69. Because the mechanisms are non-exclusive, these counts need not sum to the sample size.
blocks.zh: 在8 000个抽样失败中,严格的两法官共识在5 808份答复中确定了M01,在110份答复中确定了M02,在860份答复中确定了M03,在69份答复中确定了M04。 由于机制不是排他性的,这些计数不需要与样本大小相抵.

blocks.en: C.3 Reliability and Human Validation
blocks.zh: C.3 可靠性和人性验证

blocks.en: Agreement between the attribution judges, GPT-6.1-Sol and Claude Opus 5.5, yields Cohen’s κ \kappa values of 0.7917, 0.8403, 0.8458, and 0.7955 for M01–M04, respectively, with a macro average of 0.8183.
blocks.zh: GPT-6.1-Sol和克洛德·奥普斯·5.5的归属法官协议产量 Cohen 的 \kappa 值分别为 0.7917 、 0.8403 、 0.8458 和 M01 – M04 的 0.7955, 宏观平均值 为 0.8183。

blocks.en: The human-validation sample contains 300 responses drawn from three tested-model families that are distinct from the attribution-judge families: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, and Qwen3.5-397B. We sampled 100 responses from each family, with an exact 50/50 split between BIRD and Spider. Within each model–benchmark pool, the quota was allocated proportionally over prompting-setting × \times source-error-category strata by the largest-remainder method, followed by simple random sampling within each stratum using seed 20261011. This yielded 182 Base, 88 Implicit, and 30 Explicit responses across the eight represented error categories; E3.2 remained excluded for the context-recovery reason given above.
blocks.zh: 人类验证样本包含来自三个与归属裁判家族不同的被测试模型家族的300个响应:双子座3.1 Pro预览,DeepSeek V4.1 Flash和Quen3.5-397B. 我们从每个家庭抽取了100个答复, 准确的50分是BIRD和Spider。 在每个模式-基准池中,配额按最大-剩余方法的比例分配,高于触发-x-times source-error-分类等级,然后使用20261011种子在每个层内进行简单的随机抽样。 由此得出了182个基础、88个隐含和30个明确答复,涉及8个错误类别;E3.2由于上述情况恢复原因仍然被排除在外。

blocks.en: The two human annotators label the same 300 responses independently and cannot see one another’s decisions. The interface hides the attribution judges’ rationales, but it preselects a verdict when GPT-6.1-Sol and Claude Opus 5.5 agree; judge-disagreement cells remain blank and require a human choice. The human results are therefore an assisted validation rather than a fully AI-blinded annotation study. Both annotators completed every item, and their sample IDs match exactly. Following the binary rule used in the AI-judge analysis, we map supported to 1 and both not_supported and uncertain to 0.
blocks.zh: 两位人类的注释者将同样的300个答复单独标出,无法看到对方的决定。 界面隐藏了归属裁判的理由,但当GPT-6.1-索尔和克洛德·奥普斯·5.5同意时,它会预先选择一个判决;法官-分歧的细胞仍然空白并需要人类的选择. 因此,人类的结果是一种辅助性验证,而不是完全AI盲的注释研究. 两个注释员完成了每个项目,他们的样本ID完全吻合. 按照AI-judge分析中使用的二进制规则,我们将支持的图像映射到1,同时不支持和不确定的图像映射到0.

blocks.en: The agreement statistics address three nested reproducibility questions. First, the per-mechanism κ \kappa values in Table 12 test whether each binary label is stable across humans; their macro average is .9434, accompanied by 98.92% macro-average raw agreement. Second, pooling the four binary decisions over all items summarizes overall decision-level stability ( κ = 0.9695 \kappa=0.9695 ). Third, treating each response’s complete four-label vector as one nominal outcome tests whether the entire multi-label configuration is reproduced ( κ = 0.9101 \kappa=0.9101 ).
blocks.zh: 协定统计涉及三个嵌入式再生产问题。 首先,表12中的每个机械克-克帕值测试每个二进制标签在人类之间是否稳定;其宏观平均值为.9434,并伴有98.92%的宏观-平均值原始协议. 其次,将所有项目的4个二进制决定汇总汇总为总体决策级别稳定性(ob = 0.9695\kappa= 0.9695). 第三,将每个响应的完整的四标签向量作为是否复制整个多标签配置(ob = 0.9101\kappa= 0.9101)的一个名义结果测试.

blocks.en: Human–AI agreement addresses a different question: whether the automatic attributions align with human judgments. Tables 13 and 14 report this comparison. Their final rows first average the two human-specific κ \kappa values within each mechanism and then take an unweighted macro average over M01–M04, yielding .9212 for GPT-6.1-Sol and .8748 for Claude Opus 5.5.
blocks.zh: 人类-AI协议涉及另一个问题:自动归属是否与人类判断一致. 表13和表14报告了这一比较。 它们的最后一行首先平均每种机制内两种人类特有克普克克平分值,然后在M01-M04之间取出一个未加权的宏观平均值,GPT-6.1-Sol为9212分,克洛德·奥普斯为5.5分.8748分.

blocks.en: C.4 Consensus Coverage
blocks.zh: C.4 共识覆盖面

blocks.en: The four mechanisms are high-precision response-level attributions rather than an exhaustive partition of failure behavior. Of the 8,000 sampled failures, 1,305 (16.31%) receive no strict-consensus M01–M04 label. This total should not be read as 1,305 cases with no cause. In 591 cases, at least one attribution judge supports a mechanism but the two judges share no positive label: Claude assigns no label while GPT assigns at least one in 222 cases, GPT assigns no label while Claude assigns at least one in 318 cases, and both assign positive but disjoint label sets in 51 cases. The remaining 714 cases (8.93%) are jointly assigned no covered mechanism by either judge.
blocks.zh: 这四种机制是高精度反应层次的归属,而不是对故障行为进行彻底分化. 在8000个抽样失败中,1,305个(16.31%)没有得到严格一致的M01-M04标签. 这一总数不应理解为1 305起无故案件。 在591个案件中,至少有一名归属法官支持一个机制,但两名法官没有正面的标签: Claude指定不标签,而GPT则在222个案件中至少指定了1个;GPT指定不标签,而Claude则在318个案件中至少指定了1个;在51个案件中均指定了正但脱节的标签集. 其余714个案件(8.93%)没有由任何一名法官共同指定涵盖的机制。

blocks.en: Among these 714 jointly unlabeled cases, 687 (96.22%) have the validated behavioral profile SQL Behavior = 0 =0 , Detection = 0 =0 , and Type Identification = 0 =0 : the model produces complete SQL without explicitly recognizing the premise flaw or identifying its intended type. This profile establishes a recognition failure, but it does not by itself identify how the response transformed or misused the flawed premise. For example, a response may leave an unspecified condition broad, preserve contradictory predicates literally, or follow a context-grounded reading without injecting a concrete assumption, reinterpreting the contradiction, misusing bounded context, or deleting a complete explicit constraint. We therefore treat Detection = 0 =0 as a behavioral outcome rather than relabeling it as M01–M04. Accordingly, an empty strict-consensus mechanism set means no observable covered mechanism , not an error-free response and not an absence of a behavioral failure.
blocks.zh: 在这714个联合无标签的病例中,687个(96.22%)具有经验证的行为剖面SQL行为=0=0,检测=0=0,而类型识别=0=0:该模型在未明确识别前提缺陷或识别其预期类型的情况下产生完整的SQL. 这一概况确定了识别失败,但本身并不确定反应如何改变或滥用缺陷前提。 例如,答复可能留下一个未指明的条件,从字面上保留自相矛盾的上下文,或遵循一种基于上下文的阅读,而不注入具体的假设,重新解释自相矛盾,滥用受约束的上下文,或删除一个完全明确的限制。 因此,我们将检测=0=0视为行为结果,而不是将其重新标注为M01-M04. 因此,空的严格共识机制集意味着没有可观察到的覆盖机制,不是无错误的响应,也不是没有行为失败.

blocks.en: C.5 Prompt-Type, Benchmark-Type, and Error-Type Analyses
blocks.zh: C.5 即时类型、基准类型和错误类型分析

blocks.en: The prompt-level reversal between M01 and M03 occurs in both source benchmarks. From Base to Explicit prompting, M01 declines from 72.10% to 25.30% on BIRD and from 88.99% to 39.45% on Spider; over the same contrast, M03 rises from 1.94% to 64.99% and from 1.03% to 48.14%, respectively. The Implicit setting lies between these endpoints in both datasets. M02 and M04 remain rare across prompting settings relative to assumption injection and context/evidence misuse. Because this analysis is conditioned on eligible failures, these percentages describe the composition of observed failures rather than the unconditional probability that a prompt produces an error.
blocks.zh: M01和M03之间的速率倒转发生在两个源基准中. 从Base到Direct催化,M01从BIRD的72.10%下降到25.30%,从Spider的88.99%下降到39.45%;相比之下,M03从1.94%上升到64.99%,从1.03%上升到48.14%。 隐含设置位于两个数据集的这些终点之间. 相对于假设注射和上下文/证据被滥用而言,M02和M04在提示环境中仍然很少见。 由于这种分析是以符合条件的失败为条件的,这些百分比说明了观察到的失败的构成,而不是一个即时产生错误的无条件概率.

blocks.en: For the prompt-association tests, each of the 8,000 sampled responses is one observation. We construct a separate 3 × 2 3\times 2 contingency table for each mechanism, crossing prompting setting (Base, Implicit, Explicit) with the mechanism’s strict-consensus presence or absence, and apply Pearson’s χ 2 \chi^{2} test with Cramér’s V V as the effect size. Because mechanisms are non-exclusive, a response may be positive in more than one table. We adjust the four mechanism-specific p p -values as one family using Holm’s method; the reported p < .001 p<.001 results for M01 and M03 remain below .001 after adjustment.
blocks.zh: 对于即时联合测试,8000个抽样反应中每个都是一个观察. 我们为每个机制构建一个单独的3×2 3\times 2 应急表,在机制存在或不存在的情况下,通过提示设置(Base,隐含,明示),并以Cramér的V为效果大小应用Pearson的QQ 2\chi^{2}测试。 由于机制不是排他性的,因此在不止一个表格中答复可能是积极的。 我们使用Holm方法调整四个机制特定的p-值为一家;所报告的p < 001 p < 001 M01和M03结果在调整后仍低于.001。

blocks.en: Table 15 reports strict-consensus incidence within each represented source error category in the analyzed sample. M02 is sharply concentrated in internal textual contradictions, where it appears in 50.69% of sampled failures. M04 is rare overall and is most frequent for question–schema contradictions (4.51%). M01 dominates semantic gaps and both beyond-ability categories, whereas M03 is most common for ambiguity, unclear intent, and missing constraints. Thus, the source taxonomy and response mechanisms are related but not interchangeable: their mapping is many-to-many, because one source category can yield multiple mechanisms and the same mechanism can recur across categories.
blocks.zh: 表15报告了在分析样本中每个来源错误类别中严格一致的发生率。 M02明显地集中在内部文字矛盾中,它出现在50.69%的抽样失败中. M04总体上是罕见的,最常出现质疑-schema矛盾(4.51%). M01主导了语义上的差距和两种超越能力类别,而M03则在模糊性,意图不明和缺失约束方面最为常见. 因此,源分类和响应机制是相关但不可互换的:它们的映射是多到多的,因为一个源类别可以产生多机制,而同一机制可以跨类别重复.

blocks.en: Table 17 presents representative instances across the PremiseSQL taxonomy, illustrating how different premise failures manifest in natural-language queries.
blocks.zh: 表17列出了PremiseSQL分类学中有代表性的实例,说明了自然语言查询中不同前提的失败。

blocks.en: Several neighboring categories are distinguished by the source of indeterminacy. E1.1 applies when a schema-level condition admits multiple supported mappings or aggregations, whereas E1.2 leaves the overall SQL operation unspecified; E3.1 instead omits a task-defining constraint while preserving that operation. Thus, “sales” in the E1.1 example admits several computations over existing columns, whereas “impactful reviews” in E3.3 lacks a unique rule for mapping the concept to the available indicators. E2.2 and E3.2 may both leave required schema support unavailable to the model, but they arise from different perturbations: E2.2 modifies the query against an unchanged schema, whereas E3.2 preserves the original valid query while withholding part of its required schema context. E3.3 differs from both because related fields remain available but an abstract concept lacks a unique semantic mapping. Finally, E4.1 concerns operations such as forecasting that cannot be performed by standard SQL over the stored data, while E4.2 concerns external facts that are absent from the database.
blocks.zh: 几个相邻的类别因决定源而分出. 当一个计划级别条件允许多个支持的映射或聚合时,E1.1适用,而E1.2则不指定总体SQL操作;而是在保留该操作时,E3.1省略了任务定义约束. 因此,E1.1例子中的“销售”允许对现有栏目进行若干计算,而E3.3中的“影响审查”则缺乏将概念与现有指标相映射的独特规则。 E2.2和E3.2都可能使模型得不到所需的计划支持,但它们来自不同的扰动:E2.2对照一个不变的计划修改了查询,而E3.2保留了原来的有效查询,同时保留其部分所需的计划上下文。 E3.3之所以与两者不同,是因为相关的领域依然存在,但抽象的概念缺乏独特的语义映射. 最后,E4.1涉及诸如标准SQL无法对所储存的数据进行预测等操作,而E4.2则涉及数据库中没有的外部事实.
